name: Porchlight
verified: 2026-10-10 · Porchlight (no version stamp on the page; house layer dj-house-v63)
intro: You will answer Porchlight’s set-up questions, then see how it sorts EXAMPLE emails (a family note, a scam, a reminder, an ad) and turn one into a to-do. You never connect a real email account in this test — choose Yahoo Mail when asked, never Gmail.

steps.do: When the app opens you see “Welcome to Porchlight”. Scroll down a little and tap the big blue “Let's get started” button.
steps.see: The helper (a round “S”) says “First things first. What would you like me to call you?” with a “Your name” box.
steps.tip: At first the button sits under the purple test-copy bar — scroll down a little to reach it. If Porchlight instead opens already set up and greets someone by name (for example “Good morning, Margaret”), start fresh: tap the ⚙️ “My Setup” button at the bottom right, scroll to “Start fresh”, tap “Erase my information”, then “Yes, erase everything”. The welcome screen comes back.

steps.do: Without typing anything, tap “Next”.
steps.see: You stay on the same question and a short note says “Please type your name, then tap Next.”

steps.do: Tap the “Your name” box, type the name below, then tap “Next”.
steps.see: “It's nice to meet you, Margaret O'Brien! What would you like to call me?” with four name choices: Sunny, Grace, Buddy and Penny.

steps.do: Tap “Penny”, then scroll down and tap “Next”.
steps.see: The helper’s circle now shows “P” and it says “Thank you, Margaret O'Brien. I'm Penny. What would you like my help with?” with a list of choices.

steps.do: Tap “Sort my email” and “My to-do list” (both get a tick), then scroll down and tap “Next”.
steps.see: “Let's start with your email. Which email do you use?” with choices like Gmail, Outlook or Hotmail, Yahoo Mail.

steps.do: Tap “Yahoo Mail” (not Gmail), then tap “Next”.
steps.see: A card “Here's the easiest way” lists steps starting “Go to mail.yahoo.com and sign in.”, and says that until then you’ll see example emails on the Mail page. Don’t follow those steps — just read them.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “Next”.
steps.see: “Whose emails should always come first?…” with an “Add a person” box and the line “No one added yet. That's okay. I'll still spot emails from real people.”

steps.do: Tap the “Add a person” box, type the name below, then tap “Add this person”.
steps.see: A tag “Sarah ×” appears and the “No one added yet” line is gone.

steps.do: Tap “Next”.
steps.see: “Here's what your Home page will show…” with “1. My mail” and “2. My to-do list”, each with ▲ ▼ arrows.

steps.do: Tap “Next”.
steps.see: “Last question. How big should the words be?” with three “Aa” choices: Big, Bigger, Biggest.

steps.do: Tap “Bigger”, then tap “Next”.
steps.see: The words get larger, and a page says “All set, Margaret O'Brien!” with a “Take me to my Home page” button.

steps.do: Tap “Take me to my Home page”.
steps.see: A greeting with your name (“Good …, Margaret O'Brien”) and today’s date, a “My mail” card with “Go through my mail”, and a “My to-do list” card saying “Nothing on your list. Enjoy your day!”. A row of icons sits at the bottom.
steps.tip: The names under the bottom icons are hidden by the purple test-copy bar — tap the icon itself.

steps.do: Tap “Go through my mail”.
steps.see: A note says “These are example emails to show you how I sort mail…”. Four groups: “Needs your answer (1)” (Sarah — Sunday dinner?), “Be careful — may be a scam (1)” (Amaz0n Security), “Good to know (1)” (Dr. Patel's Office) and “Can wait (ads and newsletters) (1)”.

steps.do: Under the scam email “URGENT: Your account is suspended”, tap “Show me why”.
steps.see: A panel opens with a warning: “Be careful. Fake urgency and a misspelled sender… Don't click links, call numbers, or send money from this email.”

steps.do: Tap “Close” at the top of that panel. Then, under Sarah’s “Sunday dinner?” email, tap “Help me answer”.
steps.see: Sarah’s email opens with a section “Your answer to Sarah (your daughter)”: a “What do you want to say?” box, a “Your answer” box and a blue “Send my answer” button.

steps.do: Tap the big “Your answer” box, type the answer below, then tap “Send my answer”.
steps.type: Yes, I will be there Sunday at five. I will bring a pie.
steps.see: A note says “This is an example email, so nothing was sent. With your real Gmail, this button sends your answer.”

steps.do: Scroll up in the same panel and tap “Add to my to-do list”.
steps.see: A dark bubble briefly says “Added to your to-do list.”

steps.do: Tap “Close”, then tap the ☑️ check-box icon at the bottom (the To-Do button, middle).
steps.see: “My to-do list” shows “Follow up: Sunday dinner?” with “From an email by Sarah (your daughter)” under it.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Porchlight opens on your Home page with your name, and the “My to-do list” card shows “• Follow up: Sunday dinner?”.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Tap the ☑️ To-Do icon, type the item below in “Add something to remember”, tap “Add to my list”, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.type: Call the pharmacy about my refill
steps.see: Even with no internet, “Call the pharmacy about my refill” appears at the top of your list, with “Follow up: Sunday dinner?” below it.
